title: When the Well Falls
author: Juniper Ashgrove
blurb: Theo Ravensworth, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
